Question 5
?

Find the projection of the intersection between the hyperboloid of one sheet (x+3)2+y24−2z2=1 and the plane x+2z=−3 onto the xy-plane.

a
y24+(x+3)24=1
b
y24+(x+3)22=1
c
y24−(x+3)28=1
d
y24−(x+3)24=1
e
y24−(x+3)22=1
